changes_made.explanation: Removed 'Code Generation' as the paper doesn't evaluate code generation tasks. Simplified outputs to core NLG outputs. The paper focuses on image captioning (scene descriptions) and action sequence generation.
Normalized 'execution rate' to 'Execution Rate' and removed duplicate. All metrics are correctly extracted from the paper.
No LLMs are used as judges/evaluators in this paper. LLMs are used for generation (APM), not for evaluation.
The paper does not conduct human evaluations. Only automatic metrics are used for evaluation.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on embodied AI/robotics with NLG components. The NLG tasks are image captioning (scene understanding) and action sequence generation. All automatic metrics are correctly identified. The extraction was generally accurate, with minor normalization needed.
